profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer in Test
profile.summary:
Programming Languages: JavaScript, Ruby, Ruby on Rails, Swift
Web Automation Framework: Cypress.io, Webdriver.io, Capybara
IOS Automation Framework: XCUITest Automation, Appium
CI/Build Tools: Jenkins and Docker, CircleCI, AWS
Load Testing: JMeter, Flood.io, BlazeMeter
Testing Strategies: Black/White Box Testing, Smoke & Regression Testing, REST API Testing, Manual Testing
Other Tools: Git/GitHub, Visual Studio Code, XCode, Postman, Sequel Pro, Jira, Trello, Zephyr, Jest
Database: MySQL

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer in Test
positions.description:
o	Researched on ArcGIS API and automated end to end workflow for data export functionality using APIs and Cypress.
o	Developed end-to-end tests and integration tests using Cypress.io.
o	 Worked on BE tests using Jest, Supertest - Node.js library
o	 Researched and leading efforts to transition to TestRail for testCases management and automated
test coverage.
o	Worked on testing new features, verifying defects, coordinated with different teams and led efforts
for regression/smoke testing, release planning, validation and deployment.
o     Configured DevOps Azure pipeline to run tests for subscription users.

positions.title: Sr SQA Engineer III
positions.description:
Worked on setting up and developed end-to-end tests using Cypress.io
o	Automated email testing using Mailosaur API with Cypress.
o	Researched and configured “cypress-visual-regression” library with Cypress for snapshot/screenshot compare tests.
o	Coordinated with team to develop API to create test data endpoint to support Cypress tests.
o	Configured Cypress to run using Docker to add it to CI/CD pipeline.
o	Setup Jenkins job to run Cypress tests parallel for faster execution.
o	Configured Cypress with Cypress Cloud for better visualization for viewing test results.
o	Created documentation for Cypress End-to-end tests.

	Configured and setup JMeter tests to perform load/performance testing.
o	Ran performance/load tests to measure throughput and average response time.
o	Developed and created load testing repository using Taurus library and BlazeMeter to help with Bronze requirement. 
o	Used Charles Software and Postman to capture API requests for JMeter.

Worked on automating iOS app using XCode simulator, XCUI Automation framework and SwiftUI to automate test for iPad and iPhone app
o	Developed iOS sync test to automate interaction between native app and mobile web testing.
o	Configured testResult summary page to view test results using XCTestHTMLReport and XCResult file.
o	Started using TestPlan in XCode along with gpx file that allows you to test custom location.
o	Setup parallel tests using xcodebuild command.
o	Configured and setup Vapor MacOS machine to run iOS Unit tests and iOS end to end tests on CloudOS Jenkins.
o	Researched on iOS snapshot test using iOS snapshot test case library.

Coordinated with Team for testing new features, verified defects, performed regression / smoke /load testing for releases for iOS / Web, wrote script to validate data and lead the release management process.
positions.insights: Performance Testing / load testing, Jenkins and +5 skills

positions.title: Sr SQA Engineer I
positions.description:
Worked on Setting up Jenkins + Docker environment to run feature specs and Unit tests
o	Configured Jenkins jobs such as Multibranch pipeline, MultiJob project, Freestyle project, etc.
o	Configured GitHub Webhook and GitHub pull request builders plugin to build Jenkins job for each pull request and each commit
o	Created dockerfile and did setup on jenkins to run feature specs inside docker container
o	Configured Jenkins to run con-current builds
o	Configured build reports using rspecJUnitFormatter to help catch sporadic spec failures
o	Setup ubuntu machine on AWS and added to Jenkins as slave
o	Wrote Jenkinsfile for iOS and web to run unit tests + feature specs on Jenkins

Wrote frontend UI tests (feature specs) for web using Capybara
Improved ruby script to create sample data, added rake task and implemented API endpoints
Wrote smoke tests using webdriver.io to automate main functionality testing for web
Collaborated with developers to test various functionalities and to test migrations
Verified defects, tested functionalities, performed regression testing and white/black box testing for iOS and web
positions.insights: Performance Testing / load testing, Jenkins and +3 skills

positions.title: QA/Support Intern
positions.description:
•	Identify bugs by reproducing it in the system
•	Validate transactional and analytic report using SQL
•	Work with engineering to validate SQL persistence code prior to ship.

honors.title: Participated in Emerging Leaders program by Autodesk
honors.description:
o Met new SQA Engineers at work.
o Became member of Toastmaster and gave speeches.
o Did few automation presentations at work.
